title: I used GPT 6 Astra to build a StarCraft-inspired RTS with two playable races
author: jargs92
selftext:
I wanted to see how far I could take a game project with Astra, so I made an RTS inspired by StarCraft II.

It has two playable races, and every character has unique dialogue voiced through ElevenLabs. For the models, I connected Astra to 3D AI Studio through MCP and used that to generate the assets.

I also tried a separate workflow: making a model of St Paul’s Cathedral in Blender, then turning it into an FPS in Unreal Engine.

Both projects are part of a video where I experiment with Astra across game development, 3D modelling, filmmaking and music. There’s also a physics-based musical instrument built in Three.js.

Here’s the video if you’re interested in the process:  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iEup5H2FxKE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iEup5H2FxKE)

replies.author: jargs92
replies.body: I used Ultra, on the $200 subscription. And to answer your prompt question too: from memory, the starting request was pretty simple—essentially asking it to make an RTS inspired by StarCraft II. Then I iterated on it over several days, with 3D AI Studio for the models and ElevenLabs for the unit voices. It was a really fun project to see come together!
